notes: Loyal to Ysoly and the likeliest man on the train to sell a piece of news to Bell Harrow, and he holds both without strain. He talks continuously while he works and goes silent when he is calculating, which is the only warning anyone gets. The chapter 3 split needs no informer planted from outside; it needs Pell to have been himself since chapter 1.
